customer_avatar_contract.evidence_rule: Unsupported demographic, psychographic, quote, objection, buying-behaviour and causal detail must remain NOT_EVIDENCED, HYPOTHESIS or TO_RESEARCH. Synthesized copy is never customer verbatim.

live_form_invariants.invariant: Ten avatar cards remain ten cards, in the current order.
Every avatar card retains Before → After → offer/proof route anatomy.
Problem-first fallback remains between avatar grid and decision-role triad.
Decision-role triad remains DECISION_MAKER / ADVOCATE / CHAMPION.
Qualifier remains eight screens with timing + decision role grouped on live screen 2, scope maturity on screen 6 and inspection/validation trigger on screen 7.
No evidence visual may alter an avatar-card form unless the live owner structure is changed first.
